links.outcome: ChatGPT-3.5 accuracy on specialist medical genetics exam questions, by category and complexity
links.effect: 59% of 456 questions correct overall; 37% on clinical case-based questions; 63% on simple vs 43% on complex questions (P = .001).
links.quote: Accuracy differed by category: 71% for calculation-based questions, approximately 60% for genetic methods and genetic alterations, and only 37% for clinical case-based questions.

links.outcome: Reproducibility of ChatGPT answers across three repeated sessions
links.effect: No statistically significant differences across 3 repeated sessions; performance stable over time (P = .43).
links.quote: No statistically significant differences were found across 3 repeated sessions, with performance remaining stable over time (P = .43).

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT-3.5 on medical genetics specialist exam questions to benchmark baseline accuracy and consistency across simple vs. complex questions, without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
